description: This file defines a PHP class for interfacing with Microsoft SQL Server databases using the ADO data driver, including methods for transaction management, metadata retrieval, sequence creation and ID generation, and record set handling.

classes.name: ADODB_ado_mssql
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADODB_ado for connecting to MS SQL Server using ADO, with methods for transaction control, metadata, and sequence management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado_mssql
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADORecordSet_ado to handle record sets specifically for MS SQL Server via ADO.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID using @@identity.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Retrieves the number of affected rows using @@rowcount.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches column metadata from a specified table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table for generating sequence IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new sequence ID, creating the sequence table if necessary.
